protocol_observations.RAF_directories: big-endian count32 (<256), records tag16/length16 and inline payload; locations at header0x5c/0x60, optional0x78/0x7c
protocol_observations.dimension_tags: 0x100 fullsize,0x110 top-left,0x111 croppedsize,0x115 aspect; uint16BE pairs. Size/aspect pairs are height,width order. Size tags include borders, so not automatically visible Fuji crop.
protocol_observations.compression: header0x6c big-endian uint32 if first3byteszero;0uncompressed,2lossless,3lossy. SomeoldRAFheadersplaceJPEGhere, so guardheaderbounds.
protocol_observations.no_transform_claim: Metadata descriptors only; no raster crop, target alignment or new input/model semantics are inferred.
